scope: Targeted primary research, author abstracts, technical documentation and apparatus evidence. Physical derivations and scenario inputs are distinct from observed results.

sources.title: Critical analysis of Zwietering correlation for solids suspension in stirred tanks
sources.reading: Institutional primary abstract and publisher-indexed introduction/equation. Direct publisher request returned 403; institutional direct retrieval timed out. Full article and figures not read.
claims: Empirical suspension correlation has geometry and concentration limits; off-bottom suspension is a distinct operating criterion.
The published g^0.45 term is used only as an extrapolation sensitivity at lunar gravity.
limits: The abstract reports concentration-exponent revisions and requires matching geometry. No low-gravity validation.

sources.title: Suspension of microcarriers for cell culture with axial flow impellers
sources.reading: Indexed author-repository abstract and Birmingham bibliographic record. Original UM page now redirects to a consolidated repository; full article not retrieved.
claims: 19.2 L baffled vessel, approximately 20% wet-weight Cytodex 3, particle-liquid density difference 40 kg/m3.
50-90 rpm just-suspended speed; selected hydrofoils required about 0.5e-3 to under 1e-3 W/kg. Complete bed pickup could take about 40 minutes.
limits: Specific terrestrial laboratory configuration, not full bioreactor utility power, lunar performance or a universal suspension energy.

sources.title: Theoretical and Practical Issues That Are Relevant When Scaling Up hMSC Microcarrier Production Processes
sources.reading: Complete 15-page author-repository PDF retrieved to temporary storage. Targeted reading: abstract, cultivation methods 2.2, suspension/growth results and Table 1, conclusions. Indexed publisher passages supplement methods. No supplementary-data audit.
sources.retrieval: Hindawi and browser author-PDF retrieval initially failed; direct public repository download obtained the intended DOI/title PDF.
claims: Terrestrial hASC yield depends on agitation and aggregation; the highest tested rpm gave the lowest living cell density.
Large aggregates were associated with reduced living-cell density even at low shear; diffusion limitation was proposed rather than established.
Settling was used during medium exchange.
limits: No lunar or orbital comparison, no general biological growth premium, no application of 2016 clinical/market claims to the future world.

sources.title: Operation of magnetically assisted fluidized beds in microgravity and variable gravity: experiment and theory
sources.reading: Indexed publisher abstract, introduction, apparatus excerpt and conclusion; direct retrieval returned 403. No full PDF or figure review.
claims: Magnetically susceptible bed media were stabilized during aircraft microgravity tests.
Biomass-filtration experiments were terrestrial; the paper distinguishes those from the flight force demonstration.
limits: No quantified future array cost, no assertion that all orbital reactors require gravity.

sources.title: Behaviour of lunar regolith simulants in fluidised bed reactors for in-situ resource utilisation
sources.reading: Indexed primary highlights, abstract, introduction, particle analysis, abrasion discussion and conclusion excerpt. Full data/figures not read.
claims: Nitrogen fluidization of EAC-1, JSC-1A and TUBS-M was studied on Earth; particle distributions and abrasion mattered.
Sieving/preprocessing and changed gravity require additional qualification.
limits: These experiments were not conducted at lunar gravity; room-temperature model in this study is not the hot reduction process.

sources.title: The Flowability of Fine Powders in Reduced Gravity Conditions
sources.reading: Primary conference abstract indexed in search; no proceedings paper or data audit.
claims: Reduced-gravity powder-fluidization work had broad size classes and transient/time-scale limitations; follow-on rotating-drum tests included nominal lunar gravity.
limits: Qualitative support for cohesion/flowability concerns; no validated reactor-power multiplier.

sources.title: OpenFOAM v12 SchillerNaumann.C, CdRe implementation
sources.reading: Official source page, especially lines 62-69, read directly. Model implementation independently written from the standard mathematical relation.
limits: Isolated-sphere empirical relation; does not resolve particle interactions or rarefied gas. This study rejects Re>=1000 rather than extrapolating its chosen branch.

sources.title: COMSOL CFD Module User Guide 6.3, Euler-Euler drag models
sources.reading: Indexed official manual page 658, equations 6-69 through 6-71: Ergun/Gidaspow and Schiller-Naumann terms. Direct PDF find timed out; full manual not read.
claims: Packed-bed drag includes viscous and inertial terms with coefficients 150 and 1.75.
limits: The study derives an incipient-fluidization force balance from the conventional superficial-velocity Ergun form. No CFD simulation or expanded-bed prediction is performed.

sources.title: Stability study of battery coating slurries, application note MS_53, version 1.1
sources.reading: Complete three-page manufacturer primary experiment note text, methods and result discussion; no independent figure-image or raw-data analysis.
claims: 20 mL samples at 25 C were compared with optical scans; one formulation sedimented within its 26-hour observation and another showed no optical change over 120 hours.
limits: Manufacturer application note with undisclosed formulations and no lunar test. Stable scattering does not establish final electrode performance or lifetime.

sources.title: Effect of microgravity on the quality of protein crystal
sources.reading: Primary programme explanation of convection, depletion zones, sedimentation and prior experiments; no underlying experimental datasets or image review.
claims: Orbital protein-crystal work provides a competitor where reduced sedimentation and convection help.
limits: The programme states that the mechanism is not completely verified; no general lunar crystal optimum or bulk production market follows.

sources.title: Abrasion and breakage phenomena in mechanically stirred crystallizers
claims: Hours-long stirred dilute sodium-chloride crystal experiments produced fine fragments; abrasion and breakage were modeled.
limits: Specific salt, sizes and high stirring rates; no lunar damage law or economic yield parameter.

sources.title: Microgravity-Enhanced Stem Cell Selection, NASA Tech Brief GSC-15807-1
sources.reading: Complete substantive NASA record/technical-brief text and bibliographic metadata.
claims: Rotating-wall suspension and a hydrofocusing design provide Earth/space engineering controls for low shear and bubble/cell manipulation.
limits: Technical brief, not future production qualification. Historical clinical limitations and claims are not treated as current medical guidance.

inherited_evidence: The bound partial_gravity.json retains earlier casting inputs and their source qualifications; no new claim that its illustrative 100-second cure was demonstrated.
limitations: No exhaustive literature review or industrial low-gravity validation. Each direct-retrieval failure remains identified; only Jossen was subsequently obtained as the intended full PDF. External full papers remain temporary and are not redistributed.
